name: pocket-shelf
description: Android game catalog and download companion for Omnidroid

scripts.format: prettier --write assets/index.html assets/style.css assets/app.js assets/catalog.js tests/*.cjs docs/*.md README.md package.json .prettierrc.json dependencies.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check assets/index.html assets/style.css assets/app.js assets/catalog.js tests/*.cjs docs/*.md README.md package.json .prettierrc.json dependencies.json
scripts.check:syntax: node --check assets/app.js && node --check assets/catalog.js && node --check tests/ui.cjs && node --check tests/android-sources.cjs && node --check tests/android-scroll.cjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run check:syntax && npm test
